fieldValues.title: Changes outside the process leave no repeatable trail
fieldValues.statement: After the staged process has run, most of the real work on a document is done by hand: absorbing an organiser's clarifications, rewriting into the group's voice, tagging, removing remarks about people, reshaping the map. Each is a one-off script. The next run cannot repeat it, another model cannot pick it up, and nothing checks it the way the process's own stages are checked.
source_ref: Party Utility backstage WORKFLOW.md and passes/ (Dropbox, season 5), 2026-11-27: 35 hand passes after the session-notes protocol
